item.title: Johnny "V" Vernazza — Thu Aug 6, 6:30 PM — Empress Marquee Club
item.description:
Experience a true Bay Area blues and rock legend when Johnny “V” Vernazza takes the stage at the Empress Marquee Club for an intimate evening of powerhouse guitar, soulful grooves and decades of musical history.
Born in San Francisco and raised in Daly City, Johnny began playing guitar in 1963, coming of age during one of the most exciting periods in Bay Area music. The Fillmore and Avalon Ballroom were thriving, clubs filled the region, and musicians moved from one late-night jam to another.
Johnny became part of that remarkable scene, performing at the Fillmore and touring as an opening act for Quicksilver Messenger Service, War, and Big Brother and the Holding Company.
His journey also included touring nationally with the gospel group Gideon and Power and appearing on NBC’s Sonny & Cher Summer Show. item.title: SBC # 574 The Science of Motherhood: The Amazing Adaptive Powers of Breast Mil-Eva Emerson, Science Writer/Editor of Knowable Magazine — Mon Aug 10, 6:00 PM — Hopmonk Sebastopol
item.description: Eva will discuss all the wondrous and often overlooked powers of breast milk that science has confirmed and discovered. Breastmilk is often a human’s first form of nourishment outside the womb, and it is a miraculous mother creation that adapts to the baby’s individual needs. Research has discovered that the qualities and properties of breastmilk have the capacity to protect babies from disease and to support their growth and development in astounding ways. Eva Emerson, Editor in Chief Eva began her career shooting DNA into plant cells and cloning retinal genes from fish. It just got better from there. A graduate of the UC Santa Cruz science writing program, she has explained science to cartoon writers for “The Magic School Bus” TV show, written articles about the wild corners of Oahu for the Honolulu Weekly, created scavenger hunts for preschoolers at the California Science Center and interviewed Nobel laureates at the University of Southern California. item.title: Sewing Workshop — Tue Aug 11, 5:30 PM — Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library
item.description: Sew a quilted potholder at the JFK Library! The Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library is hosting a start-to-finish sewing workshop making a quilted potholder using a friendship star quilt block pattern. We will provide a limited selection of fabrics, but you are more than welcome to bring your own materials if you have any you would prefer to use. If you bring your own fabric, please make sure it is entirely made of cotton or linen because these fabrics withstand heat the best. Quilting cotton is the best for this project if you have it on hand. We have 4 sewing machines available for the workshop. If you have your own machine you would like to bring, please let us so know so we can set up the room accordingly. If you have any questions, please call the library: \(866\) 572-7587. Due to limited machinery and supplies, we require registration for this event. item.title: Pranzo di Ferragosto — Sat Aug 15, 12:00 PM — D'Argenzio Winery
item.description:
An Afternoon Italian Style – Celebrating Italian Culture with Family and Friends Benefiting the NBICF Scholarship Fund
Join us for Pranzo di Ferragosto at D'Argenzio Winery as we celebrate one of Italy's most beloved summer traditions. Gather with family and friends on the patio for a memorable afternoon featuring a delicious five-course meal of antipasti, salad, pasta, sausage, and dessert. Wine and other beverages will be available for purchase.
In Italy, Ferragosto, celebrated each year on August 15, is one of the country's most cherished holidays. Long communal tables fill town squares and streets as families and friends come together to enjoy abundant food, great conversation, and the joy of being together. Rooted in both ancient Roman and religious traditions, Ferragosto has become a nationwide celebration of summer, community, and Italian hospitality.
